source_title: Decorative LED Table Lamp Wooden Glass Ornament Two-Pack Light
description: A holiday tabletop vignette photographed at seated-to-standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a wooden table surface against a soft neutral background. The wall behind is very pale grey-white and nearly smooth, with a partially visible framed art print in the right background. A fresh pine branch hangs at the upper left edge of the frame, with fairy lights threading through the needles and glowing warm gold. The table surface is a warm mid-tone walnut in a smooth finish. Four glass dome terrariums with decorative holiday scenes inside are arranged in a loose group across the surface. Each sits on either a white-painted wood round base or a natural beech round base. Each dome contains a different miniature winter diorama: a white cottage with illuminated windows amid snowy trees, a red deer and red Christmas tree scene with fairy lights, a conical glass vase form with a reindeer and wooden tree, and a white house with green shutters amid blue trees and snow. Each dome glows with warm amber light from the miniature fairy-light strings within, casting warm pools of golden illumination on the wooden table surface. The mood is whimsical, festive, and Nordic-crafted — a holiday storytelling display. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
